portal_description:
OVN, the Open Virtual Network, is a system to support virtual network abstraction.  OVN complements the existing capabilities of OVS to add native support for virtual network abstractions, such as virtual L2 and L3 overlays and security groups.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - BW limit not applied to VM with VLAN port whose compute's NIC has type=system (JIRA:FDP-1489)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - OVN routers cause exact match on IPv6 external addresses in OVS datapath (JIRA:FDP-1560)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - [OVN][BGP] Expose config to tweak whether distributed NAT IPs are advertised on all chassis. (JIRA:FDP-1578)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - bgp: connected-as-host redistributes nat entries too. (JIRA:FDP-1579)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Packet Loss Between VMs on DPDK Compute Nodes  - Issue Persists Despite All Recommendations of KCS(7076184) Applied (JIRA:FDP-1621)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Static MAC binding "referential integrity violation" (JIRA:FDP-1640)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - [OVN][BGP] ovn-controller should handle old kernels that don't support filtered route netlink dumps (JIRA:FDP-1653)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - BGP: connected-as-host redistribution requires an LRP with an IP (JIRA:FDP-1654)

* OVN 25.03 FDP-ovn-25.1 RHEL 10 Release (JIRA:FDP-1672)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - [OVN][BGP] ovn-controller modifies the host routing table while dumping its contents (JIRA:FDP-1678)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - DVR + VLAN Tenant Network + reside_on_redirect_chassis False . Connectivity issue to external network (JIRA:FDP-1721)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - ovn-nbctl --wait=sb returns too early (JIRA:FDP-1723)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - ping6 from floating ip to external would fail (JIRA:FDP-1742)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Many Mac_Binding related transaction errors when using IPv6 (JIRA:FDP-1744)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Skip ARP proxy for unicast ARP request to known address (JIRA:FDP-1872)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Upstream: ovn-controller may perform very cpu-heavy computations translating != prefix matches to openflow (JIRA:FDP-2120)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Add ovn-nbctl command to create localnet port (JIRA:FDP-2113)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Add ovn-nbctl command to connect LS with LR (JIRA:FDP-2114)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Upstream: OVN dynamic-routing - ovn-controller continuously tries and fails to create invalid VRFs (JIRA:FDP-2232)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Upstream: OVN dynamic-routing - unable to use the same VRF ID for different logical routers (JIRA:FDP-2233)

* CLONE [ovn25.03 fast-datapath-rhel-10] - Upstream: route won't be learned by ovn when dynamic-routing-port-name is set for lrp (JIRA:FDP-2234)
